## Goal
- Execute the owner-mandated 200-root live certification (ROOT-001→ROOT-200): audit, repair, test, deploy via TEAM-12, and verify IVX end-to-end with per-root evidence, ending in exactly one status VERIFIED / FAILED / BLOCKED.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Work ROOT-001→200 in order; each root ends PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N-A; no proof = no PASS; every FAIL gets defect ID, root cause, files, fix, retest; fix-and-continue automatically, don't stop at defects
- Per-root evidence: root#, test name, Task ID, timestamps, env, expected/actual, logs/response codes, files inspected/changed, defect ID, retest, Proof Ledger ID; code changes add repo/branch/SHA/tests; deploys add Render service+deploy ID, prod URL, /health, runtime SHA, rollback ref
- Deployment authorization: GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest, branch main, Render ivx-holdings-platform srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0; one active prod deploy at a time; TEAM-12 Release Manager only; no VERIFIED until new live deploy tested
- Certification requires: all critical roots PASS, ROOT-200 = 10 complete real dev cycles, API health, owner auth, 503 recovery, Android+web pass, honest iOS readiness; else "IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER — NOT YET CERTIFIED"
- Final response format: overall result, roots passed/failed/blocked, critical failures, defects fixed/remaining, files changed, commit SHA, Render Deployment ID, health results, platform QA table, 10-task table, ledger IDs, honest terminal status (VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED)
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com, userId 9b280e15-f9fd-459f-bf2d-530b1ed84cb1) sole production authority; no second IVX app; preserve Expo RN codebase
- GitHub writes: POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action, action:github_commit_file, confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", input:{path,content,contentEncoding:'gzip-base64',message,branch:'main'}
- Rollback tag: action github_create_rollback_tag, same phrase, input:{branch:'main',tag,commitSha} (branch REQUIRED)
- Render deploy: action render_trigger_deploy, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY" (NOT the GitHub phrase)
- SQL action supabase_execute_sql needs confirm:true + confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION" but FAILS live: "SUPABASE_DB_URL, DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_URL, or SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD is required" — use owner tools /api/tool/:toolName instead
- Engineering OS: /api/ivx/engineering-os/tasks/{create,advance,evidence}, /status, /teams; pipeline COLLECT_BUGS→ANALYZE→GENERATE_TASKS→ASSIGN→DEVELOP→CODE_REVIEW→AUTOMATED_TESTS→SECURITY_REVIEW→PERFORMANCE_REVIEW→OWNER_APPROVAL→PRODUCTION_DEPLOY→HEALTH_VERIFICATION→PROOF_LEDGER→MONITOR; approval phrase CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL
- Cannot edit package.json via edit tool (used python3 rewrite instead)

- Watchman disabled by rename; owner session recovery = POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login (email-only)

## Next Steps
1. Poll /health until deploy final state confirmed; capture Render deploy evidence (GET /api/ivx/developer-deploy/status)
2. Advance T7-T10 through OWNER_APPROVAL (CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL) → PRODUCTION_DEPLOY → HEALTH_VERIFICATION → PROOF_LEDGER → MONITOR
3. Complete ROOTS 151-175 evidence (Android artifacts built = launch-ready; web landing 200; honest iOS readiness) + write ROOTS-151-200 artifact and commit
4. Build 10-task autonomous execution table + Proof Ledger IDs
5. Optionally clean up cert probe lead (lead-75ebe8df, cert-lead-*@certtest.ivx)
6. Emit final report in mandated format with exactly one terminal status
